### Changed

- *(verify)* Verify-migration reads the migrate Job's image pin from the charts' values (agentManager.migration.image.tag) instead of a literal, and asserts the meta chart's BOM pin and the connectivity default agree — a Renovate bump of the pin no longer breaks the check in [#379](https://github.com/giantswarm/agent-platform/pull/379) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
